title: Layout Technology Playground
description: Build layout technology: document model, WebGPU engine, 2-window playground, preflight, export/package.
summary: Built the full `layout` technology: TS document model (`layout/core`) with commands/undo, parent-page inheritance, style cascade, snap, linked-asset states, and preflight validators; Rust/WASM engine (`layout/rs`) with Parley+Swash text shaping, display list, blueprint/preview GPU render via infinite/cavas, hit testing, and PNG/SVG/PDF/package export; React bindings (`layout/react`); 2-window playground (`layout/play`) on framework playground shell with document/preflight/inspector panels and export toolbar; framework renderer `LayoutPlayHost` integration; vite aliases, launch.json `🛠️dev📄layout` on port 6079; sample fixture/manifest. All layout tests pass (core 8, react 2, play 4, rust 3); production build succeeds with layout_rs wasm bundle.
